1.t: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,

2.t: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––

3.t: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.

4.t: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,

5.t: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.

6.t: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.

7.t: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.

8.t: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––

9.t: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––

10.t: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.

11.t: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.

12.t: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.

13.t: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.

14.t: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,

15.t: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’

16.t: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-

17.t: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.

18.t: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-

19.t: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.

20.t: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’

21.t: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’

22.t: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.

23.t: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:

24.t: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.

25.t: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’

26.t: He is the One who knows what is hidden.

27.t: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind

28.t: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
